about_the_game:
Don’t be the chew toy. Don’t be the chew toy. Don’t be the chew toy. Don’t be the chew toy...

Gather your gang. Loot some houses.

Easy, right?

Well, sure. Except these houses are in the strangest neighborhood in the world, filled with bizarre mutations of science… and the Good Boy.

What is Good Boy?

A co-op horror comedy, where you and your friends attempt to gather piles of epic loot without making noise (and summoning the mutated pets that defend the town). Make it back to your hideout with your ill gotten gains, split the cash, upgrade your burglar hideout, and grow your infamy.

Of course, we can’t guarantee there will be any survivors.

content_descriptors.notes: As a member of the local burglar gang, you're looting houses and running away from the horrific pets that guard these homes.  Players will be exposed to cartoon violence and death in this game.

short_description: No one said this would be easy. No one said we’d see what we saw. Maybe we can make it out of here with a sweet wood paneled video cassette recorder. A co-op horror comedy game about burglaring with friends and avoiding strange monsters.
